name: Matthew
summary: A tax collector, also called Levi, who got up and followed Jesus when He called. He became one of the twelve apostles.

key_moments.title: Called to Follow Jesus
key_moments.description: Jesus saw Matthew sitting at the place where taxes were collected and told him to follow. Matthew got up and followed Him.

key_moments.title: Holds a Feast for Jesus
key_moments.description: Levi made Jesus a great feast in his house, with many tax collectors at the table. When the Pharisees complained, Jesus said He came to call sinners to repentance.

key_moments.title: Chosen as One of the Twelve
key_moments.description: Jesus called twelve disciples and gave them power over unclean spirits and sickness. Matthew the tax collector was named among the twelve apostles.
